title: Collins Elite met aliens and considered using them to assassinate

tellings.quote: Then you read about what they did. Well, first we met aliens and then we're like, can we use this to assassinate people?

plain: A secret group inside the US government called the Collins Elite met aliens and then asked whether they could use them to kill people, according to a guest named Kurt Metzger. He says he read it in Final Events, a book by the writer Nick Redfern, and sums it up as: "first we met aliens and then we're like, can we use this to assassinate people?"
